subject: West Stairwell
text: Running up the stairs in the West Stairwell leads through the door at their top.

evidence.quote: Run up the stairs and through the door at their top.

subject: stone block
text: Pushing the stone block with a sun panel into the beam of light on the northwest side of the room lights up the panel and opens the south door.

evidence.quote: Pull out this block, and push it into the beam of light on the northwest side of the room...The sun panel will light up, opening the door on the south side of the room.

subject: Beamos
text: A Beamos near the stone blocks can attack Link while he pushes stone blocks.

evidence.quote: Kill the Beamos near the stone blocks if you need to; it can attack you while you are pushing the stone blocks around.

subject: Silver Rupees
text: Collecting all of the Silver Rupees in the room causes the gold torch on the east side of the room to light up.

evidence.quote: Once you have all of the Silver Rupees, then the gold torch in the east side of the room will light up.

subject: chest
text: Lighting all three unlit torches with a Deku Stick before any go out causes a chest containing a Small Key to appear on the low wall in the south side of the room.

evidence.quote: Use this torch to light a Deku Stick, and in turn light all of the unlit torches throughout the room. If you can light all of them without one of them going out, then a chest containing a Small Key will appear...There are three unlit torches in the room; one near the east door, one in the northeast section of the room, and one near the south door.  The chest appears on the low wall in the south side of the room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located above the entrance door in the Upper West Stairwell.

evidence.quote: Look above the door you come through to find a Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token with the Boomerang, then go through the door at the top of the stairs.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Striking the suit of armor sitting on a throne initiates a miniboss fight against an Iron Knuckle.

evidence.quote: Run left as you enter the room to find a suit of armor sitting on a throne.  Strike the suit of armor to begin a miniboss fight.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Nayru's Love provides temporary invulnerability to attack the Iron Knuckle directly.

evidence.quote: Or the easier, faster method is to just use Nayru's Love and go kamikaze while you are invulnerable.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Once an Iron Knuckle reaches half health, part of its armor breaks off and its movement and attack speed increase.

evidence.quote: Once you whittle it down to half health, then part of it's armor will break off and his movement and attack speed will increase.

subject: West Iron Knuckle Room
text: Defeating the Iron Knuckle opens the door behind its throne leading to a tunnel back out to an arm of the Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote: Once the Iron Knuckle is dead, then the door behind it's throne will open.  Go through the door, and through the tunnel on the other side to find yourself back in the Desert Colossus, high up in one of it's arms.

subject: chest
text: Opening the chest on the left arm of the Desert Colossus awards the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: After Kaepora Gaebora's speech, open the chest in front of you to get the Silver Gauntlets.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: Playing the Prelude of Light teleports Link back to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: Play the Prelude of Light to return to the Temple of Time.

subject: Master Sword
text: Drawing the Master Sword again turns Link back into Adult Link.

evidence.quote: Retake the Master Sword to become Adult Link once again.

subject: King Zora's throne room
text: The opening behind King Zora's throne leads into Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Climb up to King Zora's throne room, and go through the opening behind his throne to Zora's Fountain.

subject: large gray rock
text: The Silver Gauntlets allow Link to lift the large gray rock blocking the cave mouth in the southeast area of Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Now that you have the Silver Gauntlets, you can lift the large gray rock in the middle of the cave mouth (it was formerly invulnerable to bombs).

subject: rock
text: Bombing the rock beneath the large gray rock exposes a pit that drops Link to a ramp winding through the outer walls of Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Underneath, you'll find another rock.  Bomb this rock to destroy it and find a pit (sometimes this rock is already destroyed).  Drop down the pit...You'll land at the bottom of a ramp, winding up through the outer walls of Zora's Fountain to an alcove high above.

subject: invisible Big Skulltulas
text: Equipping the Lens of Truth reveals invisible Big Skulltulas along the winding ramp that can be killed with the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Use the Lens of Truth as you climb up the ramp to see several invisible Big Skulltulas.  Kill them with the Longshot.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the wall to the left of the ladder's top in the high alcove of Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Kill the (not invisible) Big Skulltula at the top, and then look on the wall left of the top of the ladder to find the final Overworld Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token.

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: Playing the Requiem of Spirit teleports Link back to the Desert Colossus.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, play the Requiem of Spirit to return to the Desert Colossus.

subject: Magic Leaf
text: Planting Magic Beans as a child creates a Magic Leaf to the left of the Spirit Temple entrance.

evidence.quote: If you planted the Magic Beans as a child, then there will now be a Magic Leaf to the left of the door.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Riding the Magic Leaf and jumping off after the second rock at nighttime reveals an Overworld Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Jump off after the second rock, and if it's nighttime you'll find the game's last OVERWORLD Gold Skulltula (the final two are found in the Spirit Temple).

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Riding the Magic Leaf until it passes the arch east of the Spirit Temple entrance allows Link to jump onto the arch and obtain a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Run back to the Magic Leaf, and this time ride it around until it flies by the arch to the east of the entrance to the Temple.  Jump off the leaf onto this arch to get the Piece of Heart.
